meta.name: azure-reliability
meta.description: Assess and improve the reliability posture of PaaS Applications (Azure Functions and Azure App Service). Scans deployed resources for zone redundancy, ZRS storage, health probes, and multi-region failover. Presents a feature-pivoted checklist, then drives staged remediation (CLI or IaC patches) end-to-end with user confirmation. WHEN: "assess reliability", "check reliability", "zone redundant", "multi-region failover", "high availability", "disaster recovery", "single points of failure", "reliability posture", "resiliency".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估并修复 Azure 应用的单点故障与灾难恢复短板
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的 Azure 应用可能缺少区域冗余或健康探测
copy.tagline_en: Assess and fix single points of failure and disaster recovery gaps in Azure apps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your Azure app may lack zone redundancy or health probes

howto.what: 它会扫描你在 Azure Functions 和 App Service 上部署的资源,检查区域冗余、ZRS 存储、健康探测、多区域故障转移,先给出一张按功能排列的检查表;你确认后再分步改配置(CLI 或 IaC 补丁)。
howto.when: 当你提到「评估可靠性」「检查可靠性」「区域冗余」等关键词,或要求排查单点故障、提升可用性时触发,目前仅覆盖 Azure Functions 和 App Service。

say.text: 评估一下我这个资源组里应用的可靠性
say.note: 会输出按功能排列的检查表

say.text: 我的应用服务计划是区域冗余的吗?
say.note: 只查 App Service 和 Functions 资源

say.text: 帮我给这个应用开区域冗余并配健康检查
say.note: 会先列改动,再等你确认

howto.what_en: Scans your deployed Azure Functions and App Service resources for zone redundancy, ZRS storage, health probes and multi-region failover, shows a feature-pivoted checklist, then applies staged fixes (CLI or IaC patches) after you confirm.
howto.when_en: Triggers on keywords like "assess reliability", "zone redundant", "multi-region failover", or when you ask about single points of failure and high availability for App Service and Functions.

say_en.text: Assess the reliability of the apps in my resource group.
Is my App Service plan zone redundant?
say_en.note: Covers App Service and Functions only.

say_en.text: Make my app zone redundant and add health checks.
say_en.note: It lists changes and waits for your OK.
